identity.name: Drawlead Construction ERP
identity.tone: Warm, confident and practical — one brick red against calm warm stone greys (brick, clay, stone)
principles: One brand colour (brick #B14E2F) for actions, selection, focus and "handled" states; status colours only carry meaning
Neutrals are warm stone greys (text #171310), never cool blue-greys; secondary is near-black #0D0B09 (warm white in dark mode)
Dark–light rhythm: near-black sidebar, hero tiles and auth panel against white cards on a #FAFAF9 canvas
Rounded but not bubbly: buttons and fields 12px, cards 14–20px, pills fully round; soft warm-tinted shadows
Data is the hero: tabular figures, uppercase letter-spaced labels and table heads, airy rows

typography.secondary_font: Plus Jakarta Sans (Inter as glyph fallback)
typography.mono_font: Plus Jakarta Sans (font-mono = UI face with tabular-nums slashed-zero)

scale.h1: text-[22px]–text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight (page title in AppHeader)

secondary.DEFAULT: #0D0B09 (warm near-black; warm white in dark mode)

palette.sidebar: #0D0B09 (near-black rail; tokens --sidebar-*, incl. accent, accent-foreground, hover, strong)

scales.brand: brand-50…950: #FBF3EF #F6E2DA #EDC5B6 #DF9E86 #CD7051 #B14E2F #923F26 #773320 #5D291A #461E14 #2D120B (500 = #B14E2F); green and emerald alias brand, so legacy success utilities render brick
scales.ink: ink-50…950 warm stone grey (#FAFAF9 … #171310, #0D0B09); gray, slate, zinc, neutral and stone alias ink

status.success: #B14E2F — brick means handled (approved, paid, synced, profit)
status.info: blue and violet = labels and categories
status.toasts: sonner richColors success toasts are re-tinted brick in index.css

colors.gradients: none on surfaces — exception: dark hero tiles and the auth panel carry one soft blurred brick glow

shell.desktop: Fixed near-black sidebar (#0D0B09): 5.5rem icon rail by default (tooltips, brick logo tile with glow), expandable to 15rem with labels; active item = brick-tinted tile, light-brick label and a 3px brick accent bar; brick avatar + logout at the foot; sticky 76px light top bar with eyebrow (module · Financial Year in brick) and page title
shell.mobile: Top bar with hamburger drawer + MobileBottomNav

buttons.primary: <Button> default: bg-primary text-white font-semibold shadow-brand (brick glow) hover:bg-primary-hover hover:shadow-brand-lg
buttons.secondary: variant="secondary": near-black bg, white text (inverts in dark mode)

cards.kpi_tile: <SummaryCard> (components/SummaryCard.jsx): uppercase label, tinted icon chip top-right (or a tone dot when there is no icon), large black figure, tone-coloured sub-line; tones neutral|positive|negative|warning|info|violet; `active` for filter cards, `compact` for dense rows
cards.hero_tile: <SummaryCard hero> or the same markup: rounded-3xl bg-ink-950 text-white with one blurred bg-primary/25 glow and a brick pill label — at most one per page, for the headline figure
cards.channel_card: <ChannelCard> (components/SummaryCard.jsx): coloured dot + uppercase label, figure, optional label/value rows and a bar; `danger` for negative/overdrawn, `dark` for the total card, `compact` for strips of four or more. Channel dots: Cash violet-500, HDFC Current orange-500, HDFC Savings primary, Cheque ink-700, Cash DT blue-500

inputs.base: h-9 rounded-lg border-input bg-background shadow-xs hover:border-ink-300 focus-visible:border-primary focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-ring/15 (faint brick outline)

tabs.style: Every tab is its own bordered pill (rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm): idle bg-card border-border text-muted-foreground; active bg-primary-soft (blush) border-primary/50 (brick) text-primary-strong font-semibold. Tabs sit apart with gap-2 — no shared track, no underline.
tabs.radix: <TabsList>/<TabsTrigger> render the pill by default — pass only layout classes (grid, flex-1, w-full, text size, px), never colours, borders or data-[state=active] styles.
tabs.buttons: Hand-rolled tab buttons and nav strips use tabChipClass(active, 'size/layout classes') from components/ui/tabs.jsx.

tables.head: h-11 px-4 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground, no fill

badges.solid: <Badge> default (solid brick; call sites pass their own bg-*)
badges.soft: variant soft|warning|danger|info: pale tint + matching -200 border

visual_enhancers.shadows: tailwind shadow-xs…2xl with a warm brown-black tint; shadow-brand / shadow-brand-lg = brick glow on primary buttons, the logo tile and the avatar; shadow-ring = faint brick focus outline

motion.entrance: animate-rise — cards slide up 10px and fade in on mount (SummaryCard, ChannelCard)
motion.hover_lift: .card-lift — clickable cards lift 2px and draw a brick accent line along the top edge
motion.live: .live-dot — pulsing ring for live or urgent items (e.g. <span class="live-dot h-1.5 w-1.5 bg-red-500" />)
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion switches all of this off (spinners keep turning)

icons.style: Lucide thin outline icons, default stroke; section-title icons text-primary

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: tokens live in frontend/src/index.css (:root/.dark) and tailwind.config.js — never hard-code the brand hex in pages; use bg-primary / text-primary-strong / brand-*.
2. FONT: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter as glyph fallback (both loaded in public/index.html).
3. ACTIONS: primary actions use the default <Button>; destructive stays red; avoid per-page rainbow button colours.

4. STATUS COLOURS: brick (brand / green / emerald utilities) = done, approved, income, synced; amber = pending; red = missed/rejected; blue and violet = labels; categorical chips may use other hues as pale tints.
5. NAVIGATION: AppHeader renders the sidebar + top bar; pages only pass customNav/headerActions/backTo/hideNav.
6. MOBILE FIRST: stack forms/dashboards on mobile; large touch targets on site flows.
7. DATA-TESTID: add data-testid to every interactive element.
8. SUMMARY ROWS: never hand-build KPI tiles — use SummaryCard for counts/totals and ChannelCard for per-account or per-bucket figures; no tinted (bg-*-50) or left-border (border-l-4) tiles.
9. TABS: use <TabsTrigger> or tabChipClass — never underline tabs, segmented tracks or per-page active colours.
universal_guidelines: Flat tints on light surfaces; near-black for the sidebar and hero tiles; the only gradient is the soft brick glow on dark tiles.
Selected/active state = brick (blush tint + brick border, or solid).
Respect dark mode: prefer tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border) over raw white/gray.
